title: Austin's license plate cameras
subtitle: The city switched its own readers off in 2025 and has not decided what comes next
alt: Timeline of Austin's automated license plate reader program: a Flock Safety pilot began in 2023 with 40 fixed cameras and nearly 500 vehicle-mounted cameras, the city manager declined to bring a renewal to City Council in June 2025, police switched the readers off in July 2025, the council passed a surveillance ordinance in April 2026, and as of September 2026 Austin police still receive license plate data from other agencies

events.label: Austin starts a Flock camera pilot
events.note: 40 fixed cameras and nearly 500 mounted on city vehicles

events.label: No renewal goes to City Council
events.note: City Manager T.C. Broadnax does not bring one; the pilot expires

events.label: Austin police switch the readers off
events.note: An audit found 10% to 20% of searches had no reason or case number

events.label: Council passes the TRUST Act
events.note: Surveillance tech now needs council approval and a use policy

events.label: Plate data still reaches Austin police
events.note: Partner agencies share it; no written agreements, no records kept
